results.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
results.overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

results.title: Napoleon
results.overview: Bahman and Yahya, who are in prison, plan to commit the biggest robbery of their lives.

results.title: Steps
results.overview: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.

results.title: Perfect Liars
results.overview: Jude Derry arrives at the exclusive Tagus university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. What begins as revenge turns into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction and lies, drawing her toward a truth she may not be ready to face.

results.title: Khanom valede
results.overview: The story of two brothers who are struggling financially when they suddenly receive an inheritance.

results.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
results.overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

results.title: Mones
results.overview: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

results.title: The Dreamer
results.overview: To get their hands on Grandpa’s fortune, they have to step into Grandma’s shoes... but when Grandma turns out to be a real beauty, Grandpa’s wandering eye starts to roam!

results.title: Nothing Between Us
results.overview: Living in Mexico City, Guillermo and Mechi, in Buenos Aires, are separated by over 4,000 miles and their marriages, both having structured family lives. Working for the same multinational food manufacturer they meet by chance at a corporate offsite. The attraction between them proves immediate and irresistible. The sudden spark makes them face their own desires and changes them in deeper ways than they thought possible.

results.title: The Blue Box
results.overview: Pablo is a young, wealthy but solitary man traumatized by a fatal car accident. He meets Lara through a dating app tied to an exchange of the titular blue box. As their relationship grows, Lara draws Pablo out of his shell. But an anonymous warning alerts Pablo that Lara may not be all that she seems. What begins as an intimate connection gradually turns into a tense psychological game of cat and mouse, forcing Pablo to confront both his past and the true nature of the woman he is falling in love with.

results.title: Ghermez Yavash
results.overview: The story is about a Russian girl who travels to Iran after her father goes missing, but in the meantime, her acquaintance with a boy in the south of Tehran gets her involved in a new adventure.

results.title: Thai Fighters
results.original_title: สิงห์เหนือ เสือใต้
results.overview: The story begins in two villages facing each other across a river in Thailand’s central region, once as close as family but now bitter rivals who haven’t wanted to look each other in the eye for over a decade. Pride chokes them—whoever gives in first is the loser. Then matters of the heart, wounded masculinity, and a fierce competition enter the picture, fanning the flames even higher. Just as the conflict between the two villages reaches its boiling point, a hidden threat begins to creep in, slowly and quietly, catching everyone off guard.

results.title: The Hotline
results.overview: Portrait of an anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using, and volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, forging collective hope amid addiction.

results.title: Guarding Stars
results.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

results.title: Madden
results.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football's most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

results.title: Long Haired Businessmen
results.overview: Kevin, Kyle, and Seth are long-haired, buzzword-fluent middle managers with a passion for staying looped in and on the same page. When the ruthless Torrence Group acquires their company and sics Gen-Z efficiency experts on them, the trio must survive team-building gone haywire, a scheme to replace them with AI, and a corporate conspiracy to eliminate middle management entirely - armed with nothing but jargon, synergy, and one sacred truth: the weekend’s never long enough.

results.title: Russell Brand: Open Secret
results.overview: From comedy stardom to a criminal trial, inside voices and archive footage charts British comedian Russell Brand's meteoric rise and steep fall following allegations of sexual offences.

results.title: Heartland
results.overview: Former country music legend Misty Jones returns to Nashville to unravel the truth behind her rising-star niece's disappearance.

results.title: Agent Zeta
results.overview: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.

results.title: The Christmas Switch
results.overview: Craving a change of pace, work-hard-play-hard city girl Freddie swaps lives with her homebody sister Mattie at Christmas time, only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

results.title: Best Pancakes in the County
results.overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

results.title: Allen
results.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

results.title: Never Surrender
results.overview: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.

results.title: Ebenezer
results.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

results.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.original_title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

results.title: Ghost Soldier
results.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

results.title: I Play Rocky
results.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

results.title: Being Heumann
results.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

results.title: Dilwali Diwali
results.overview: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

results.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
results.overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

results.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
results.overview: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

results.title: Overacting
results.original_title: แก๊งโอเวอร์
results.overview: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

results.title: To the Max
results.overview: A group of friends bonded by their love for extreme sports discovers BASE jumping in wingsuits — but feeling like flying carries the highest risks.

results.title: The Pool
results.overview: About a guy navigating through midlife crisis, depression, being still in love with his ex wife and his relationship with his son, all while trying to find meaning in life in general.

results.title: The Roof
results.overview: Arash is a middle-aged university professor whose home is damaged during the Israeli attack on Iran in the Twelve-Day War, and at the same time their family wedding is affected by the war. Arash, his wife Fariba, and his in-laws are forced to leave their home and Tehran.

results.title: Disneyland Handcrafted
results.overview: Oscar and Emmy nominated filmmaker Leslie Iwerks returns with an all-new Disney documentary giving viewers an up-close look at the dedication, effort, and passion that was required to realize a dream that would go on to inspire millions around the world.

results.title: High Copy
results.overview: Returning from a night party, Zohreh learns her friend Saghar has a secret: a perfect android replica of herself. Saghar uses the duplicate to slip away from the oppressive watch of her husband, tasting freedom whenever she desires. Stunned yet intrigued, Zohreh decides she needs a duplicate of her own.

results.title: Raha
results.overview: Raha, a young Iranian woman is detained inside a rigid and unforgiving prison system, accused of a crime she did not commit. Pressured by an authoritarian officer to sign a fabricated confession, she faces escalating threats, isolation, and psychological torment. As the system closes in and the cost of resistance grows heavier each day, she must decide whether to surrender to a lie that could save her life or hold on to the truth and risk an irreversible fate.

results.title: Jahiziye Babam
results.overview: A man from a low-class family faces many challenges in providing his daughter's dowry.

results.name: American Horror Story
results.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

results.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
results.original_name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
results.overview: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

results.name: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
results.overview: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

results.name: Phineas and Ferb
results.overview: Each day, two kindhearted suburban stepbrothers on summer vacation embark on some grand new project, which annoys their controlling sister, Candace, who tries to bust them. Meanwhile, their pet platypus plots against evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

results.name: The Simpsons
results.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

results.name: Grey's Anatomy
results.overview: Follows the personal and professional lives of a group of doctors at Seattle's Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital.

results.name: Slow Horses
results.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

results.name: MobLand
results.overview: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

results.name: One Piece
results.overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

results.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
results.overview: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

results.name: Tulsa King
results.overview: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

results.name: The Remarried Empress
results.overview: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

results.name: Law & Order
results.overview: In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place.

results.name: The Rules
results.original_name: กฎหลังเที่ยงคืน
results.overview: Haunted by his past, Metha takes a night shift at a mysterious convenience store where breaking its strange rules leads to supernatural death, forcing him to confront both the store's dark secrets and his own sins.

results.name: The Body
results.overview: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

results.name: VisionQuest
results.overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

results.name: Reacher
results.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

results.name: American Dad!
results.overview: The series focuses on an eccentric motley crew that is the Smith family and their three housemates: Father, husband, and breadwinner Stan Smith; his better half housewife, Francine Smith; their college-aged daughter, Hayley Smith; and their high-school-aged son, Steve Smith. Outside of the Smith family, there are three additional main characters, including Hayley's boyfriend turned husband, Jeff Fischer; the family's man-in-a-goldfish-body pet, Klaus; and most notably the family's zany alien, Roger, who is "full of masquerades, brazenness, and shocking antics."

results.name: Chicago Fire
results.overview: An edge-of-your-seat view into the lives of everyday heroes committed to one of America's noblest professions. For the firefighters, rescue squad and paramedics of Chicago Firehouse 51, no occupation is more stressful or dangerous, yet so rewarding and exhilarating. These courageous men and women are among the elite who forge headfirst into danger when everyone else is running the other way and whose actions make the difference between life and death.

results.name: Detective Conan
results.overview: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.
